entities.name: Raúl Chávez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Raúl Alexander Chávez is a Venezuelan former professional baseball catcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) from 1996 to 2009 for the Montreal Expos, Seattle Mariners, Houston Astros, Baltimore Orioles, Pittsburgh Pirates, and Toronto Blue Jays. He bats and throws right-handed.
